title: Ordinary coefficient restriction comparison is an adjunction mate
statement: For commutative condensed rings Λ, Λ′ and a ring-object morphism a : Λ ⟶ Λ′, let f : X ⟶ Y be any scheme map. The ordinary adjunctions and canonical coefficient comparisons of [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface] satisfy: the mate of the inverse comapUpperStarIso a f is exactly the hom of comapLowerStarIso a f. The square and its orientation are specified verbatim in lean.statement. No flatness, properness or nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15; the explicit comapUpperStarIso and comapLowerStarIso constructions in lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/ModuleObject/ChangeOfCoefficients.lean, and upperStarLowerStarAdjunction in UpperLowerStar/Defs.lean

proof.text: Along an isomorphism φ of ring objects, extendScalarsIsoComapInv is leftAdjointUniq against the inverse restriction equivalence. Its hom composed after extendUnitHom is the identity by homEquiv_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app, since the equivalence counit is the identity on underlying objects. Therefore its inverse has underlying map extendUnitHom.

Expand the module pullback unit: it is the underlying sheaf pullback unit followed by pushforward of extendUnitHom. Naturality of extendScalarsIsoComapInv for mapModComapIso identifies the underlying inverse comapUpperStarIso with the source scalar-isomorphism hom followed by the target scalar-isomorphism inverse. The underlying comapLowerStarIso is the identity.

The resulting unit square commutes after cancelling extendUnitHom followed by the scalar-isomorphism hom. Apply faithfulness of Mod.forget and injectivity of the ordinary pull/push homEquiv, then unit_mateEquiv_symm, to identify the mate with comapLowerStarIso. This calculation is valid on every module, including zero modules, and on empty schemes.

lean.statement:
theorem comapUpperStarIso_mate {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ' f) (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (comapUpperStarIso a f).inv) =
      TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (comapLowerStarIso a f).hom
